raw_text: The Indian Navy has issued a maritime advisory to all merchant vessels with Indian crew transiting the Red Sea and Gulf of Aden following the seizure of MV Galaxy Leader by Houthi forces. INS Kochi, currently deployed in the region as part of anti-piracy operations, has been placed on heightened alert. The advisory recommends vessels maintain maximum distance from the Yemeni coast and report any suspicious activity immediately on VHF Channel 16. The Indian Navy maintains continuous surveillance of the region through its Information Fusion Centre for the Indian Ocean Region.
